Generated Narrative: CodeSystem heartland-monitoring-track

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-monitoring-track defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
digital-track-a Digital Track AA planned digital route, such as app-based entries. This code alone does not assert Bluetooth devices, automatic transmission or reliable connectivity.
analog-track-b Analog Track BA planned analog route, such as telephone contact and a paper diary. This code alone does not assert telephone access, staff entry, successful contact or review.

name: HeartlandMonitoringTrack
title: HEARTLAND Monitoring Track
description: Documented monitoring routes with stable Track A and Track B codes. A route does not establish equivalent outcomes, successful contact, device availability or completed monitoring. Clinical requirements are not reduced by the route; access, preference and the supported local plan require separate documentation.

concept.definition: A planned digital route, such as app-based entries. This code alone does not assert Bluetooth devices, automatic transmission or reliable connectivity.
A planned analog route, such as telephone contact and a paper diary. This code alone does not assert telephone access, staff entry, successful contact or review.
